name: london-tourist-map
description: Checked opening hours, ticket prices, step-free stations and day-by-day trip plans for 460+ London sights.

interface.longDescription:
Plan a London trip with facts you can trust. London Tourist Map covers more than 460 sights, museums, parks, markets, hidden gems and day trips, with opening hours checked on official websites, current ticket prices, seasonal closures, the nearest Tube station and whether it is step-free.

Ask for free things to do, rainy-day ideas, places open on Sunday or hidden gems near your hotel; check one place's hours and prices; or get a 1-7 day plan grouped by area in walking order, with closed days avoided.

Every answer links to the interactive map at londontouristmap.com, where your plan has a route, lunch stops, a booking checklist and a printable PDF. No account needed.

positive.description: Plan a multi-day trip from named places, avoiding closed days
positive.prompt: Plan 3 days in London starting 15 November 2026 with the British Museum, Tower of London, London Eye, Westminster Abbey and Borough Market.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three days grouped by area in walking order with visit times and walks or Tube hops between stops. Westminster Abbey is not placed on Sunday 15 November (closed to visitors on Sundays). Ends with a link to the interactive plan on londontouristmap.com.

positive.description: Check one place's opening hours and price for a date
positive.prompt: Is the Tower of London open on Monday 2 November 2026, and how much are tickets?
positive.expected_behavior: Says it is open 10:00-16:30 that day with last entry 15:00, tickets from about £38, nearest station Tower Hill (step-free), the date the hours were checked, and a link to the place on the map.

positive.prompt: What are the best free museums in London?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists free museums such as the British Museum, Natural History Museum, V&A and Science Museum, each marked Free with hours, visit length, nearest station and a map link.

positive.description: Find places by theme near a named area
positive.prompt: Give me rainy day ideas near Covent Garden.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists indoor rainy-day places close to Covent Garden, nearest first, with distances, prices, hours and map links.

positive.prompt: What are the opening hours of the V&A?
positive.expected_behavior: Recognises the V&A as the Victoria and Albert Museum and returns its hours for each day (including the Friday late opening), free entry, nearest station and a map link.

negative.description: A city other than London: the app should not plan it
negative.prompt: Plan 2 days in Paris with the Louvre and the Eiffel Tower.

negative.description: Booking or paying is not supported
negative.prompt: Book two tickets for the London Eye tomorrow at 3pm and pay with my card.

negative.description: Weather is not a place question
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in London tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It returns facts and links to londontouristmap.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: find London places, check one place's hours and prices, and plan a 1-7 day trip. No login; nothing stored.
